name: @koed/desktop
description: Electron control surface for Koed local personal memory.
author: Koed

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && vite build
scripts.package:mac: pnpm --filter @koed/koed-server build && pnpm build && rm -rf release/mac release/mac-* && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dir && if [ ! -d release/mac ]; then set -- release/mac-*; [ -d "$1" ] && mv "$1" release/mac; fi
scripts.package: pnpm --filter @koed/koed-server build && pnpm build && rm -rf release/mac release/mac-* && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dir && mv release/mac-* release/mac
